description: Generate a slide deck from a brief and iterate against two evaluators — accessibility on slides (AA with large-text thresholds, scope:deck) and deck quality (penpot-build-deck references/07-critique-framework.md + the structural gate) — until both gates pass.
exit: AA pass on slides (no High/Medium) AND deck-quality pass (no axis < 3, structural gate pass) OR maxIterations reached -> present remaining issues + weak axes + unlinked slides
output: report: { deckPageId, slideCount, flowName, iterations, finalA11y, finalDeckQuality }
